scripts.uji:hidromet: for f in scripts/cuaca/metar.py scripts/cuaca/mjo.py scripts/banjir/faktor_orografi.py scripts/banjir/faktor_surut.py scripts/cuaca/bahan_badai.py scripts/banjir/jeda_hulu.py scripts/cuaca/jam_hujan.py scripts/cuaca/siklon.py; do python3 -I "$f" uji || exit 1; done
scripts.uji:hidromet:jaringan: for f in scripts/udara/awan_himawari.py scripts/udara/awan_tumbuh.py; do python3 -I "$f" uji || exit 1; done
scripts.uji:siklus: for f in scripts/siklus/*.py; do python3 -I "$f" uji || exit 1; done; node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/siklus/*.test.mjs tests/warga/siklus_*.test.mjs
scripts.uji:insiden: for f in scripts/data/progresi.py scripts/umum/paparan_insiden.py; do python3 -I "$f" --uji || exit 1; done; python3 -I scripts/data/arsip_insiden.py --uji
scripts.uji:kemitraan: python3 -I scripts/kemitraan/konst.py --cek && python3 -I scripts/kemitraan/kode.py --cek && python3 -I scripts/kemitraan/geo.py --cek && python3 -I scripts/kemitraan/masalah.py --cek && python3 -I scripts/kemitraan/pertanyaan.py --cek && python3 -I scripts/kemitraan/korpus.py --cek && python3 -I scripts/kemitraan/teks.py --cek && python3 -I scripts/kemitraan/indeks_bm25.py --cek && python3 -I scripts/kemitraan/cocok_pakar.py --cek && python3 -I scripts/kemitraan/uji_cocok.py --cek && python3 -I scripts/kemitraan/profil_daerah.py --cek && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/kemitraan/*.test.mjs tests/warga/kemitraan_*.test.mjs
scripts.uji: npm run uji:agen; a=$?; npm run uji:warga; b=$?; npm run uji:sippa; e=$?; npm run uji:banjir; c=$?; npm run uji:udara; d=$?; npm run uji:prediksi; f=$?; npm run uji:wa; g=$?; npm run uji:siklus; h=$?; npm run uji:paritas; i=$?; [ $a$b$e$c$d$f$g$h$i = 000000000 ]
scripts.tinjau:pasang: sed "s#REPO#$PWD#g" scripts/agents/tinjau_lokal.plist > ~/Library/LaunchAgents/id.centurisk97.tinjau-lokal.plist && (launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/id.centurisk97.tinjau-lokal 2>/dev/null; launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/id.centurisk97.tinjau-lokal.plist) && echo http://localhost:8800
